data.one_liner: Isar Plus Core binaries for the Isar Plus Database
data.what_it_does: Provides the native binaries required to run the Isar Plus Database on Flutter platforms including iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux. It is automatically included when adding the main isar_plus dependency.
use_when: Using the isar_plus database package in a Flutter application
Targeting iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, or Linux with Isar Plus
avoid_when: Building a Dart-only application without Flutter
Using a completely different database solution like drift or sqflite
strengths: Provides precompiled native binaries for multiple Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Not intended to be used directly by developers
Limited standalone utility outside of the isar_plus package
data.setup_notes: Needs to be included as a dependency alongside isar_plus.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a traditional SQLite database for Flutter.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a reactive SQLite database with type-safe queries.
